sources.note: Town of Westford, Town Report 2026 (for the March 2026 annual meeting), 'ELECTED TOWN OFFICES' and 'APPOINTED TOWN OFFICES' lists: Selectboard -- Deb Sawyer Jorschick (term expires 2026); Casey Mathieu (2026); Patrick Haller (2027); Julia Andrews (2027); William "Nick" Nichols (2028)

Town of Westford, Selectboard minutes, March 12, 2026: 'Casey Mathieu and Deb Jorschick had been reelected to the Selectboard at the March 3, 2026 Town Meeting and there were no changes to the makeup of the Selectboard'; the minutes elect Patrick Haller chair

Town of Westford, Town Report 2026 (for the March 2026 annual meeting), 'ELECTED TOWN OFFICES' and 'APPOINTED TOWN OFFICES' lists: 'Town Clerk (3 years, term expires 2028): Callie Hamdy'; the report's March 2025 meeting minutes record her election to the three-year term
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 163 (Town of Westford): sec. 2: the elected officers of the town are those required by state law, elected by Australian ballot
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 163 (Town of Westford): sec. 3: the Selectboard appoints the Town Treasurer
Town of Westford, Town Report 2026 (for the March 2026 annual meeting), 'ELECTED TOWN OFFICES' and 'APPOINTED TOWN OFFICES' lists: 'APPOINTED TOWN OFFICES: Town Treasurer -- Gregory Barrows'

Town of Westford, Town Report 2026 (for the March 2026 annual meeting), 'ELECTED TOWN OFFICES' and 'APPOINTED TOWN OFFICES' lists: Library Trustees -- Patricia Hechmer (term expires 2026); Kelsi Cross (2027, marked '(Appointed)'); Marianne Bassford (2028); Helen Sterling, Chair (2029); Becky Roy (2030) -- five-year staggered terms. Cross is seated as an appointee on the elected board; Hechmer's seat stood at the March 2026 meeting with no published outcome -- straggler

Town of Westford, Town Report 2026 (for the March 2026 annual meeting), 'ELECTED TOWN OFFICES' and 'APPOINTED TOWN OFFICES' lists: 'Town Moderator (1 year, term expires 2026): VACANT' -- the 2025 holder, Lee McClenny, departed and the 2026 floor outcome is unpublished, so the post is created without a membership

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists seven Westford justices of the peace: Caroline Brown, Lynn Bursell, Christian Frenette, Martha Heath, Andrea Letorney, Derrick Kendrew, and Francois Ross

Town of Westford, Town Report 2026 (for the March 2026 annual meeting), 'ELECTED TOWN OFFICES' and 'APPOINTED TOWN OFFICES' lists: the town report's justice of the peace list names Dennis Angiono, Martha Bennett, Lynn Bursell, Andrea Letorney, Christian Frenette, Suzanne Blanchard, and Martha Heath -- a three-name divergence from the certified slate at equal count (it omits Brown, Kendrew, and Ross). The certified listing governs; Angiono, Bennett, and Blanchard are held as stragglers (possible Board of Civil Authority appointees), flagged on #163
